title: Line sketch: Vibrant Dripping Paint Orbs
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: circular paint blobs in various sizes drip downwards against a white background with a top edge. The fluid forms blend multiple hues with dynamic splatters and flowing drips creating an abstract composition (derived from painting #591).
